name: dataset-task-manager
title: dataset-task-manager
description: Controlled feature-evolution dataset for a Maven JavaFX task manager with feature mapping files and annotations.

provenance.collection_method: A Maven JavaFX task manager was evolved through 14 sequential benchmark steps. Each step records the prompts, expected feature-level changes, and manually curated post-step traceability artifacts.
provenance.source: The subject is the task manager seed project in project/, including its feature model, Java source files and JSON persistence layer

benchmark.ground_truth_policy: Each step stores the expected post-step traceability artifacts.
